notes: No frozen source or historical testcase was modified.
No concentration cap, mass deletion, mass creation or invented external outflow is admitted as a solution.
Conservation closure of Candidate A is necessary evidence but is not treated as proof of ANIMO-specific intended physics.
The provisional continuation-state name is deliberately chemically noncommittal until theory establishes residue, sorption, precipitation or residual-film semantics.
The blocker is now narrower: conservation need and the exact representation seam are established; physical phase identity and remobilization are not.
The previous wording that the 0.1 mm cutoff was purely Transsub-local has been corrected. The effective boundary is shared with hydrological ponding activation.
The separate 1 mm UBoundconc dry-deposition routing threshold is recorded as an ancillary seam without claiming causal relevance to TCD-016.
